page.overview:
What is Clan Novel 7: Assamite?

Clan Novel 7: Assamite is a fiction novel for Vampire: The Masquerade. This book is the seventh of the Clan Novel Saga and focuses on clan Assamite.

The novel was reprinted as part of an Omnibus edition, Clan Novel Saga Volume 1: The Fall of Atlanta, in 2003.

The 1999 Jul-Dec Catalog has a different text entry for the book:

This book, Clan Novel: Assamite, is the eighth of a 13-book series concerning the Kindred - the hugest event ever in the World of Darkness.
